## Summary of Modified TypeScript Files

Based on the git diff and file examination, here's what changed in each file:

### **resource/ts/app.ts**
**Purpose:** Entry point for the application; handles startup sequencing and lifecycle management
**Changes:** Added bfcache support with `pageshow` listener to reinitialize the app when a page is restored from browser cache. Replaced `beforeunload` with `pagehide` event to avoid blocking bfcache entry (+13 lines)

### **resource/ts/app/ResizeSetup.ts**
**Purpose:** Handles window resize events and applies responsive snapshots to the engine
**Changes:** Entirely new file. Implements a resize listener setup class that debounces resize events and syncs responsive state (viewport dimensions) with the engine. Also supports visualViewport for mobile browsers (+9 lines new)

### **resource/ts/config/component.config.ts**
**Purpose:** Central configuration for UI components and visual settings
**Changes:** Added `CHAR_BTN` config object with button styling and animation settings for a character-based button component. Also exports `DRAWER_GNB_RECT` for animated drawer navigation rectangle styling (+26 lines)

### **resource/ts/core/AnimationLoop.ts**
**Purpose:** Core animation frame scheduler managing update and render loops
**Changes:** Added bfcache support with `pageshow` listener. When page is restored from cache, forces RAF chain restart since JS execution paused. Also added visibility change handling to pause/resume loop when tab loses/gains focus (+20 lines)

### **resource/ts/lib/lenis/LenisRuntime.ts**
**Purpose:** Manages smooth scrolling via Lenis library integration
**Changes:** Already existed with bfcache support. Minimal changes - synchronized RAF chain restart when page is restored. Added pointer event tracking for scrollbar drag detection and syncing with ScrollTrigger

### **resource/ts/manager/AppManager.ts**
**Purpose:** Main orchestrator for page initialization and scene management across main/about/contact pages
**Changes:** Significantly refactored lifecycle management - cleaned up contact form success flow sequencing, improved DOM state synchronization for contact wizard, enhanced scene transition and background controller integration. More robust error handling and disposal chains (+48 lines, -40)

### **resource/ts/pages/works/render/WorksSceneManager.ts**
**Purpose:** Renders and manages 3D work card scatter/grid views
**Changes:** Already existed. No changes in diff but file uses bfcache-aware patterns and improved resource cleanup with `disposeObject3D` utility

### **resource/ts/pages/works/runtime/WorksPageRuntime.ts**
**Purpose:** Controls Works page state, grid feed pagination, category filtering
**Changes:** Major additions - new `WorksGridFeedRuntime` class for infinite scroll grid with IntersectionObserver, category filtering modal, video hover preview system. Separated concerns into `WorksPageDomRuntime`, `WorksProjectsLoader`, `WorksPageUiRuntime` classes for better maintainability (+1,200 lines of complex logic)

### **resource/ts/runtime/PageRuntime.ts**
**Purpose:** Generic page runtime coordinator initializing UI systems and effects
**Changes:** Added Feature Card Canvas runtime (particle + 3D cube animation) and Subpage Starfield runtime (scrolling parallax stars). Both get initialized and disposed properly with error handling in disposal (+14 lines for new integrations)

### **resource/ts/runtime/PinnedRevealRuntime.ts**
**Purpose:** Manages pinned scroll-triggered reveal animations via GSAP/ScrollTrigger
**Changes:** Minor - added support for exit animations with `exitAnimation` config. Also added responsive "viewport-auto" end trigger mode that calculates scroll distance based on section height vs viewport height (+5 lines)

### **resource/ts/runtime/SubpageStarfieldRuntime.ts**
**Purpose:** Renders animated starfield parallax effect on specific subpages (contact/careers/inside)
**Changes:** Entirely new file. Implements scrolling 3D starfield with scroll velocity boost animation, decay/lerp dynamics, and bfcache support. Uses ResponsiveRuntime for pixel ratio clamping (+25 lines new)

### **resource/ts/types/component.types.ts**
**Purpose:** Type definitions for component configurations and interfaces
**Changes:** Added new interfaces for SubpageStarfield config, PinnedRevealAnimation configs, and restructured animation/component type exports. Also added char button and various preview option types (+25 lines)

### **resource/ts/ui/Drawer.ts**
**Purpose:** Slide-out navigation drawer with animations and accessibility
**Changes:** Enhanced with GNB (Global Navigation Bar) rect animations and magnetic corner support. Added async state management and better aria/accessibility patterns. Improved scroll lock integration with Panel (+102 lines, -11 removed)

### **resource/ts/ui/Header.ts**
**Purpose:** Page header managing drawer toggle and scroll state visualization
**Changes:** Added queued visibility state for managing transitions and Panel visibility coordination (hides Panel when drawer opens, restores state on close). Better state machine for transitions (+14 lines)

### **resource/ts/ui/WorkCard.ts**
**Purpose:** Renders work card canvas textures with images/videos and metadata overlays
**Changes:** Entirely new file. Implements canvas-based card rendering (images, videos, category badges, titles) with caching. Static method API for creating meshes, updating textures, and managing Three.js materials (+88 lines new)

### **resource/ts/utils/Device.ts**
**Purpose:** Device detection and viewport information utility
**Changes:** Added iOS visualViewport support for accurate mobile viewport height detection. Improved device type detection for iOS vs Android vs desktop (+11 lines)

### **resource/ts/utils/PerformanceProfile.ts**
**Purpose:** Adaptive performance profile selection based on device capabilities
**Changes:** Minor - adjusted scoring logic for performance tier selection. Slightly lower thresholds for mid/low tier detection to be more conservative on lower-end devices (+2 lines, -1)

---

## Overall Pattern: **bfcache (Back/Forward Cache) Support + Enhanced Mobile + New Works Page Grid View**

The changes primarily add:
1. **bfcache compatibility** across core systems (app, animation loop, lenis, starfield)
2. **Mobile improvements** (visualViewport, device detection, responsive performance)
3. **Works page grid view** with infinite scroll, filtering, and category management
4. **Visual enhancements** (starfield, feature card particles, drawer animations)
5. **Better lifecycle management** and resource cleanup patterns
